reference: The original generic GGML CPU reads the signed source words, computes 432 binary32 graphs and stores each result via its integer read and write APIs. The right operands use the same GGML and SoftFloat decoders as VT-188. Independently execute the pinned GGML SYCL k_bin_bcast_unravel body and its four original operators on host-indexed lanes for its registered I16/I16 and I32/I32 forms. Eight boundary cases exercise rounding beyond 24 significant bits, cancellation, multiplication and truncating division. The host supplies lane coordinates and modulo addressing. The original SYCL input conversions, arithmetic and output casts run unchanged with float-cast-overflow checking.
